861:t_154:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Finally, you need conversational skills! Let's go, stop being the quiet type!」

861:t_154:9.en:
$n
「...I... You were all that worried about me...?」

861:t_154:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah! He's getting even more like the quiet type!」

861:t_154:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We're joking. It's just a joke!」

861:t_154:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've been flashing some great smiles lately!」

861:t_154:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hurry up and lift your head. We're going to keep playing the game.」

861:t_154:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Player, do your best alongside the $$リアクター$$s as we approach the end of 'Super Robot Wars Z'!」

861:t_155:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's your familiar $$ビーター・サービス$$. Please come to us for all your repair needs.」

861:t_155:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We're the combat research team $$グローリー・スター$$. Leave the setup of any unit to us.」

861:t_155:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm $$スコート・ラボ$$'s $$次元獣$$ Buster. If you're having trouble with $$次元獣$$s, get in touch right away.」

861:t_155:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then shall we help everyone out in the spirit of volunteering too?」

861:t_155:8.en:
$n
「You mean we'll do repairs, unit setup AND $$次元獣$$ extermination!?」

861:t_155:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course we will. We're young, so let's do our best.」

861:t_155:10.en:
$n
「...At this rate, I'll never have time to take a break...」

861:t_156:3.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「My name is $$アウストラリス$$. I am Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

861:t_156:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Earthlings. Train, learn and better yourselves.」

861:t_156:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Then, once you have rested and regained your strength, challenge me again.」

861:t_156:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I await you in the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

861:t_157:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Super Robot Wars is fun, isn't it?」

861:t_157:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's because fighting is fun, of course... In short, you players are just like me.」

861:t_157:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Come back soon, my darling. Then let's resume our heart-pounding battle.」

861:t_157:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll be waiting. Next time you meet me on the battlefield, I'll shower you with kisses of cannon fire!」

861:t_158:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I have nothing in particular to say.」

861:t_158:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But keep playing the game. That is all I ask.」

861:t_159:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hatred lives in everyone, and the slightest trigger can make it erupt...」

861:t_159:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When an enemy dodges an attack with over 90% hit chance... or lands one with a single-digit hit chance... people hate the game...」

861:t_159:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Yes... 'Super Robot Wars' is a game that makes hatred grow.」

861:t_159:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「With that power beside me, I will never lose... no matter how many times you challenge me.」

861:t_159:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you still insist on fighting, I'll be waiting for our rematch. Hehehe... Hehehehehe...」
